data.content_ref: inline:The variance-reduction mechanism is asserted, not causally derived. Labeling the panel a 'distributed processing unit' and invoking 'single point of failure' is metaphorical; it does not supply the causal mechanism by which distributing cognition across non-experts with a checklist shifts mean reliability above the expert. The target even concedes 'lower-peak' performance but never causally explains why the reduction in catastrophic-failure probability outweighs the loss of high-peak performance on tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes, leaving the central reliability claim unsupported by a demonstrated causal chain.
